## Playbook Checklist

- [ ] Requirements and acceptance criteria are met.
- [ ] Responsibilities remain separated across UI, hooks, domain, and services.
- [ ] New or changed components use semantic HTML and accessible names.
- [ ] Keyboard-only interaction and focus order were checked.
- [ ] Empty, error, success, loading, and disabled states were considered.
- [ ] Inputs are validated and user-generated output is encoded or rendered safely.
- [ ] Sensitive data is not logged, stored in URLs, or committed.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for changed business rules and regressions.
- [ ] `npm run quality` passes.
- [ ] Documentation or manual QA notes were updated where useful.
